Three.js 0.185.1 — local, unmodified minified ES-module runtime.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.185.1.tgz
Upstream: https://threejs.org/ — MIT license included in LICENSE.

Only the opt-in 3D character mode loads these modules. No CDN or package install
is required to run the game. Serve over HTTP for ES modules (python serve.py).
